_what_this_is: the probes A18 runs. Each one names a place where the record and reality can diverge, and how to tell. Adding an installation means adding probes, not changing code.

_the_two_directions.backward: recorded rows that never became real — simulations, reversals, parked documents
_the_two_directions.forward: configured entries that never produce a document — designed but dormant
_the_two_directions.backward_flag: recorded rows whose OWN indicator changes their standing. CRITICAL DISTINCTION, learned by getting it wrong: NEVER_REAL (deleted, reversed, simulated) invalidates a sum of WHAT HAPPENED. NO_LONGER_LIVE (completed, cleared) does NOT — a completed commitment is the most real kind, it became an actual. It only invalidates a sum of WHAT IS OUTSTANDING. Treating the second as the first would have destroyed a correct figure

backward._why: THE ONE THAT COST NINE TIMES. Payroll posting runs write documents whether or not they are real; only reaching FI distinguishes them.

coverage_guard._why: bkpf in the golden covers 2024-2026 only. Outside that window every payroll run looks like a simulation and is not.

forward._why: THE MIRROR ERROR. 72 Constant Dollar wage types, all configured, all identical, described as the mechanism. Zero of them post.
forward.document_covers: ppoix holds 2026 and POSTED RUNS ONLY. 'Dormant' therefore means 'unused in 2026 real postings', not 'never used'

forward._why: a symbolic account configured for posting that no payroll item ever uses is capacity nobody is exercising.
forward.document_covers: ppoix holds 2026 and POSTED RUNS ONLY. 'Dormant' therefore means 'unused in 2026 real postings', not 'never used'

backward_flag._why: a commitment that has been deleted or completed is a record of something that FINISHED, not something that IS. Summing FMIOI without checking these counts closed commitments as open ones — and FMIOI is the base of the non-personnel budget-rate impact A14 measured

flags._why: completion indicator — the commitment is finished
statistical: recorded but does not consume budget

backward_flag._measured_s098: A14's route-2 population is 27,453 lines and only 552 lack ERLKZ. That is NOT a defect in A14: those commitments completed because they became actuals. A14 measures the valuation applied when the commitment existed, which completion does not undo. The -2,365,688.44 USD figure STANDS

backward_flag._why: a reversed FI document is a document that was undone. It still sits in BKPF.

flags._why: reversal document number — this document was reversed
